scientific_integrity: The determinant polynomial identity has a finite exact 833-point interpolation certificate; independent direct enumeration corroborates through n=18. No independent external validation or audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: For n>=5 only: simple squared cycles, closed-neighborhood capacity three, labelled vertex subsets. The stated result does not count inclusion-maximal sets. The all-order proof uses an exact 16-state determinant and coefficient extraction. Historical novelty is provisional.
title: Three-limited packings of squared cycles: a rational census and five-residue optimum laws
